body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> LG presented its LED ultra mobile projector ''HS101'' with 20,000 hours of lamp life during CES 2007. It measures 154mmx117mm at 750g.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Niki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Sirh >
